text:
Philadelphia bụ William Penn hiwere na 1682 ma too bụrụ obodo kasị ukwu na mpaghara America, na-eje ozi dị ka isi obodo United States n'oge ọtụtụ nke oge Revolutionary. Ọ bụ ebe amụrụ nnwere onwe America: ma Declaration of Independence na 1776 na U.S. Constitution na 1787 ka e binyere aka na Independence Hall. Ihe nketa ahụ na-enye ebe obodo ahụ na maapụ 2026 World Cup ụgwọ ihe atụ, dị ka Philadelphia na-anabata egwuregwu Round of 16 na July 4 — Independence Day — n'ime afọ ncheta 250th nke United States.

Ọtụtụ obodo America na-eyi nkwado egwuregwu ha n'ụzọ doro anya dị ka Philadelphia. Metro na-ebu ndị na-akwado ọkụ nke Eagles na NFL, Phillies na MLB, 76ers na NBA na Flyers na NHL, nraranye nke na-agba ọsọ site na mpaghara niile karịa otu otu ọ bụla. N'akụkụ soccer, metro bụ ụlọ nke MLS Philadelphia Union, ndị na-egwuri egwu na Subaru Park na Chester kemgbe 2010, na-akwado ọnụnọ ọkachamara nke ọkwa dị elu maka egwuregwu na mpaghara ahụ.

Ihe nketa bọọlụ mba ụwa nke obodo ahụ dị adị ma nwetara ya n'ebe ahụ n'onwe ya. Lincoln Financial Field emela egwuregwu Copa America Centenario, 2015 CONCACAF Gold Cup ikpeazụ, na egwuregwu metụtara USMNT, na-etinye akụkọ ihe mere eme bọọlụ ọkwa dị elu n'ezie n'elu metro nke gbanyere mkpọrọgwụ na egwuregwu nnukwu ihe omume. N'ịchịkọta — akụkọ ntọala, ihe ndị dị mkpa nke iwu, na omenala egwuregwu dị ka ọkụ dị ka nke ọ bụla na mba ahụ — Philadelphia na-abata na 2026 World Cup dị ka obodo nnabata ebe njirimara obodo na ịnụ ọkụ bọọlụ na-ezute n'otu ala.
